title: Megurine Luka — Wiping Away Twilight Rain〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The stars are always so beautiful here...hmm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Luka! Hello there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello there, Saki. I haven't seen you since we used the rooftop as a play-planetarium.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm glad you seem to be in good health today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Actually, I brought some photos that Hona took for us the other day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...these are shots from the play-planetarium.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They're very well taken.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! Please show them to Miku too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I will.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And now you can tell me what you're really here for.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah... Haha, you can really read me like an open book.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, I'm here to say thanks, actually.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, for listening to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You told me back then that there was no need for me to rush.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think those words really put me at great ease.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I'm all better now. It's all because of you, Luka. So thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You didn't have to worry about it at all, really.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of you found your true feelings in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you let us hear the wonderful songs that were born from those feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To Miku and myself, that's more than enough thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So now, just go out there and do whatever you like, and enjoy life to your heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's what we want to see all of you doing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so reassuring to have someone like you and Miku I can look up to as my seniors!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... If I ever need help for anything in the future, can I drop by to talk to you again, in secret?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Without telling Ichika, Shiho, and Honami?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes. Secretly and without letting them know!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, there are some things you wouldn't be able to share freely with those who've known you since you were little.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I'm happy to lend you a listening ear anytime you like. Miku would say the same thing too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's already quite late. Let's stop for today, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay. Good night!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, good night to you too, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like Saki's made a full recovery.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, she has. Miku, you didn't come in just now so that it would be easier for Saki to speak with me, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were outside the classroom from halfway through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup. She just recovered from an illness. It wouldn't be nice for me to make her stay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Besides, Saki's here to thank you today, wasn't she?
I didn't want to be in the way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that why? But she said it's so reassuring to have someone like Miku she can look up to—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, well, that's...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Oh, Miku. You heard what she said, didn't you?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Maybe you didn't come in because you were blushing?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka? Why are you staring at me like that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, nothing in particular.
